svg.text: C4 Code: STS tokens and presentations in portitor-identity
Two HTTP edges of the identity component, what they sign with portitor-dcp, and the ports (traits, dashed yellow) and adapters they use
The participant's P-256 key; it never leaves
An at+jwt for our Credential Service: for one
verifier, with the scopes it may read
A scope by type or by id: parse; does a scope
A scope type T covers a credential of type T, or
of gx:T when its @context names a Gaia-X
One presentation per profile, for the verifier,
POST /sts/token: the own connector gets a self-issued ID token for
an audience, with an access token if it asks for scopes
POST <credential service>/presentations/query: the verifier's token, its access token, then the credentials the asked scopes and the access token both allow (visible, covers), not expired
The STS client secret, compared in constant time
The verifier's self-issued ID token: validate_self_issued, each
did:web with a cache, over HTTPS
Database adapter, one file per process
C4 model, level 4. Solid arrows: uses. Dashed arrows: implements. The key signs every token, access token and presentation here; the connector only asks the STS.
